tools.name: scan_domain
tools.description: Scores a domain across 5 funnel stages using 16 deterministic HTTP checks. 18 points exist on paper; the score is out of the points that both applied to the domain and could be evaluated. Returns a per-check breakdown with the reason for each result and a permanent link.

tools.name: find_providers
tools.description: Describe the problem in your own words, for example "let users upload images" or "send transactional email". Returns the vendors we have measured in that category, split by whether an unattended run clears every barrier we test, stops at one, or was never measurable, each with the date and a link to

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_providers · Public sink: find_providers · Destructive: find_providers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_providers · Public sink: find_providers · Destructive: find_providers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
